name: Financial services
summary: Payments, banking and settlement. Identity abuse, fraud and extortion lead; energy and connectivity shocks hit operations.

name: Energy and utilities
summary: Generation, transmission and oil and gas. OT exploitation and destructive attacks lead; Gulf and Ukraine theaters weigh heavily.

name: Water and wastewater
summary: Treatment and distribution OT. Internet-exposed PLCs are the dominant risk; Iran-linked activity weighs heavily.

name: Healthcare and public health
summary: Providers, payers and medical devices. Ransomware and data extortion lead, with device and supply-chain exposure.

name: Telecommunications
summary: Carriers and ISPs. State intrusion into routing and interception leads; identity and edge exposure follow.

name: Government and defense
summary: Agencies, defense-industrial base and critical services. Espionage, sabotage and influence lead across every active theater.

name: Manufacturing
summary: Discrete and process manufacturing. The most-claimed sector on leak sites; ransomware, supply chain and OT lead.

name: Transportation and logistics
summary: Aviation, shipping, rail and logistics. Maritime chokepoints and OT exposure lead; ransomware disrupts operations.
